title: Black Snow
overview: Iwamoto Kodo has a mission: finding special individuals to attend a special military school.

title: The Bond-Severing Sickles
overview: Iwamoto joins up with another student from Seiho to investigate a mysterious shrine.

title: The Lad Who Loved Insects
overview: A massive cocoon appears in the barracks, and Iwamoto has to discover where it came from.

title: The Legend of the Dead and the Gas Refinery
overview: Iwamoto comes across a community where rumors of the walking dead lead to a disturbing discovery.

title: Deicidal Flame
overview: Iwamoto is forced to unleash his powers against the mastermind behind the Ryugu Palace slaughter.

title: Invasion of the Witches
overview: A new recruiting mission puts Iwamoto and Haramachi into conflict with witches from England.

title: Echoes of Destruction
overview: The clash with the witches continue, with some unexpected assistance coming from Sazame Ryu's rain.

title: AKA The Box Man
overview: Iwamoto is recruited by the person who recruited him, Okuaki Oni, to capture the elusive box man.

title: The Gap Man and the Box Man
overview: Iwamoto's investigation into the box man brings him into conflict with one of his recruits.

title: The Simultaneous Shooting Stars & the Signal Man and the Spirit Photo Man
overview: When mysterious meteor impacts start peppering the entire Japanese countryside, Iwamoto investigates.
